claim_support_checks.claim: Authentication strength policies work together with MFA trust settings in cross-tenant access settings to determine where external users must perform MFA.
If MFA trust is enabled, Microsoft Entra ID checks the user's authentication session for a claim indicating that MFA was fulfilled in the user's home tenant.
Authentication strength policies currently only work for external users who authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID.
For email one-time passcode, SAML/WS-Fed, and Google federation users, the MFA grant control must be used instead of authentication strength.
Built-in authentication strengths include Multifactor authentication strength, Passwordless MFA strength, and Phishing-resistant MFA strength.
Authentication strengths are evaluated after the initial authentication, and users can be prompted to provide a method that satisfies the strength.
